en:
You know...Monokuma hasn't presented us
with a motive yet.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Keebo for a while?

Perhaps he's expecting Kokichi to act on
his own without even needing a motive.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I spent some time
looking for Kokichi...
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
